description: Rewrites a passage of text at the sentence and clause level, preserving meaning, facts, numbers, names, and code, while removing the statistical pattern that Claude content detectors flag. Use this to clean text copied from Claude, Claude Code, or the Claude API before publishing.

text.description: The text to rewrite. Up to ~30,000 characters per call. For longer documents, split into parts and call multiple times.

name: rewrite_text
title: Rewrite text to remove the Claude watermark
